decisions.division: Biohazard Spill Kit Duo 2 Pack All In One
decisions.why: the single product, Biohazard All In One Spill Pack, is a body-fluid spill kit — absorbent granules and chlorine disinfectant for decontaminating an environmental spill — matching the Phase C decisions that put this supplier's Sochlor chlorine disinfectant products in facilities:clean
the single product, Chemical Spill Kit, is an environmental spill clean-up consumable, same reasoning as the biohazard spill pack and the Sochlor range

Large Grey Printed Confidential Waste is a sack from the same NHS colour-coded waste sack range as this supplier's already-mapped Orange, Yellow, Cytotoxic, Clear, Black, Tiger Stripe and Coloured bag divisions, all of which sit in infection:sharps
